visual_design.notes: Clean layout but clearly an old Squarespace 7.0 vanilla template. Stock-feel imagery, generic H1 ('Where Quality Counts'), rigid template structure, no custom design touches. Decent colour palette but spacing and hierarchy are template-default. Feels more 'functional' than 'crafted' — which is a problem for a cabinet maker selling quality craftsmanship.

tech_stack.framework: Legacy YUI (deprecated), no modern JS framework
tech_stack.notes: Technically very dated. Squarespace 7.0 is the older template generation, uses deprecated YUI framework. No blog, ecommerce, or dynamic features. Simple brochure site. Positive: Squarespace hosting provides basic reliability.

build_recency.assessment: Originally built 2015, content refreshed 2020, most recent update Dec 2024 (banner imagery). Owner has shown willingness to invest recently but only in superficial updates — they haven't modernised the platform.

composite.rationale: Mixed signals. Visual design is mediocre (5/10 — clean but dated template). Tech stack is very old (2/10 — Squarespace 7.0/YUI/UA). But the Dec 2024 update suggests the owner is aware their site needs attention and has recently invested time/money. This makes them more open than a typical 'set-and-forget' Squarespace owner. The opportunity is positioning a proper rebuild as the next step after their recent surface-level update. Primary angle remains 'weak quote flow' — the site has 0 forms and no clear enquiry path beyond a contact page link.
